column1: # Follow-up probes for task lifetimes, Sleep and module constants (#724): what OpenVerse prints is in each probe's header and in note; the Book's expectation where it has one; Epic's outcome and lines in epic_outcome and epic_lines (UEFN 43.12, ++Fortnite+Release-43.12-CL-60598086, Use Verse VM, newVerseVm=true, 2026-11-19; - where not yet run), its error and the comparison in note. Two differences found, both fixed: branch-cancel-order (a cancelled task stops its children before its own defers run) and cancel-branch-before-sync-arms (the arms it waits in first, as its newest children); Epic refuses cancel-task-child (task.Cancel is epic_internal), which OpenVerse admits.

column7: note

Same. Run alone (single mode): begin|main returning|end|branch cleanup, no branch tick in the 12 s after: the branch, a child of the device's OnBegin task, is stopped when OnBegin ends. OpenVerse: main returning|branch cleanup (stopped when Main, the entry, ends).

column6: winner done|branch cleanup|arm cleanup|after race|after wait
column7: Differed, now fixed (#724): a cancelled task stops its children before its own defers run. OpenVerse printed winner done|arm cleanup|branch cleanup|after race|after wait; it now prints Epic's lines.
Same. OpenVerse: runner ending|branch cleanup|awaited 5|after wait (a spawned task's children stopped before its awaiters resume).

column6: function returned|outer done|outer cleanup|inner cleanup|after wait
column7: Same. OpenVerse: function returned|outer done|outer cleanup|inner cleanup|after wait (a task that ends runs its own defers, then stops its children).
Same outcome. Epic: 3512 "This 'branch' macro has the 'suspends' effect, which is not allowed by its context". OpenVerse refuses it: branch in a defer is not supported (#156).

column7: Same. OpenVerse: winner done|winner branch cleanup|loser cleanup|after race|after wait.

column7: Same. OpenVerse: helper returning|runner after helper|branch tick|runner ending|branch cleanup|main after wait.

column6: arm one done|branch cleanup|arm two done|after sync|after wait
column7: Same. OpenVerse: arm one done|branch cleanup|arm two done|after sync|after wait.

Same outcome. Epic: 3512 "This mutable data definition has the 'allocates' effect, which is not allowed by its context", 3582 "Expressions with side effects cannot be used when defining data-members", 3582 "Divergent calls (calls that might not complete) cannot be used to define data-members", 3512 "This mutable data read has the 'reads' effect, which is not allowed by its context". OpenVerse refuses it: computing the constant Total allocates the var Sum declared in Total.

column7: Same. OpenVerse: fast arm|function returning|returned|slow arm done|slow cleanup|after wait.

column6: worker before sleep|worker after sleep|main after spawn|main after wait
column7: Same: a negative duration completes at once, without yielding. OpenVerse: worker before sleep|worker after sleep|main after spawn|main after wait.

column6: b after short sleep|a after three zero sleeps|main after wait
column7: Same: each Sleep(0.0) waits for the next update. OpenVerse: b after short sleep|a after three zero sleeps|main after wait.

column6: winner done|grandchild cleanup|child cleanup|arm cleanup|after race|after wait
column7: Same: a stopped child is cancelled the same way, its own children first. OpenVerse: winner done|grandchild cleanup|child cleanup|arm cleanup|after race|after wait.

column6: winner done|second cleanup|first cleanup|arm cleanup|after race|after wait
column7: Same: a cancelled task's children newest first. OpenVerse: winner done|second cleanup|first cleanup|arm cleanup|after race|after wait.

column6: winner done|arm cleanup|after race|spawned done|spawned cleanup|after wait
column7: Same: a spawned task is nobody's child. OpenVerse: winner done|arm cleanup|after race|spawned done|spawned cleanup|after wait.

column6: winner done|branch cleanup|sync arm cleanup|loser cleanup|after race|after wait
column7: Same: a sync arm cancelled with its task stops its children first. OpenVerse: winner done|branch cleanup|sync arm cleanup|loser cleanup|after race|after wait.

column6: winner done|arm two cleanup|arm one cleanup|branch cleanup|loser cleanup|after race|after wait
column7: Differed, now fixed (#724): the arms a cancelled task waits in go first, last started first, as its newest children, then its branch. OpenVerse printed winner done|branch cleanup|arm two cleanup|arm one cleanup|loser cleanup|after race|after wait; it now prints Epic's lines.

column6: rush done|winner done|slow arm cleanup|loser cleanup|after race|after wait
column7: Same: a rush arm that went on is a child of the task that ran the rush. OpenVerse: rush done|winner done|slow arm cleanup|loser cleanup|after race|after wait.

Epic refuses, OpenVerse admits (a known difference): 3593 "Invalid access of epic_internal function `(/Verse.org/Concurrency/task:)Cancel` from control scope"; user code cannot cancel a task on 43.12, so the race-arm probes ask the question. OpenVerse: branch cleanup|runner cleanup|cancelled|after wait.

column7: Same: a task that ends runs its defers, then cancels its children, each its own children first. OpenVerse: runner ending|runner cleanup|grandchild cleanup|child cleanup|after wait.
